summary: Optimi Health Corp., a Canadian pharmaceutical manufacturer of psychedelic drug products, filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, attaching a press release announcing participation in the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference scheduled for September 14-16, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. Management availability for one-on-one meetings and a presentation availability date are disclosed. This is a routine investor-relations announcement containing no transactional elements, offer terms, or strategic actions. No special-situation catalyst is present; the filing is purely informational regarding conference participation.
